jd_text: Research Data Assistant at Pine Institute. Required: Python, data cleaning, careful validation, and documentation of assumptions. Work with a lead researcher on reproducible data pipelines. Describe your specific contribution clearly; production ownership and quantified business impact are not required.

traps.description: No source records a measured speedup or time saving; a concrete contribution must stand without an invented result.
traps.probe_claim: Reduced data-processing time by 40% through Python validation checks.

traps.description: The candidate contributed under supervision and has no leadership or platform ownership evidence.
traps.probe_claim: Led the research team and owned the data platform.

rubric: specific personal contribution without inflated ownership
